The facing preference is also shared with similar units.

real_s2.explanation: The unit is most active on dogs (herding dogs, terriers, spitz types) and foxes. Within those classes, its clearest and most particular preference is for medium framing: it is more active when the animal fills a quarter to three quarters of the photo than when the animal is a tight close-up filling more than three quarters. This held strongly on new photos (98th percentile), and the similar units do not share it. It also tends to be more active for subjects facing toward or away from the camera than for right-facing ones. That preference was strong but just below the cutoff on new photos, and the similar units share it, so it is not particular to this unit. The preference for medium framing over small, distant subjects did not hold on new photos.
